newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan banks to cut one point on interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan banks to cut one point on interest rates.

text.p: Morocco's commercial banks said on Wednesday they would cut interest rates by one point on long term investment loans from March 1, a bank source said.
The reference rate for such loans will be 10.25 percent instead of 11.25 percent.

The banks' association, Professional Groupement of Banks, said in an advertisement published in newspapers that the reduction, for which it gave no rate, was "a promotional campaign to encourage investment".
It would be effective for investment loans taken out between March 1 and December 31 this year.
The move follows guidelines issued by the monetary authorities in January which advised banks to reduce rates to attract more investments.
In February, one of the leading banks, Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, cut its interest rates on short term loans to 9.50 percent from 9.75 percent.
